notes.title: The Wake, an award-winning cipher adventure game, launches on App Store and Google Play.
notes.notes:
Hello, my friends!

I'm excited to announce that my latest game, The Wake: Mourning Father, Mourning Mother is coming to App Store and Google Play on 2nd April.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35182344/970943077a913aed265aaa72e12572b1d17b6113.png[/img]

The Wake is a game that discovers past emotions and wounds through the process of reading and deciphering the journal which is encoded with a simple substitution cipher. 

The Wake is now available for pre-order!

[url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/the-wake/id1546739064]Appstore Link[/url]

[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.somigames.thewake]Google Play Link[/url]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oQZI8kTqobw

To celebrate the release, all my games including The Wake, Legal Dungeon, Replica and RETSNOM are giving 30-70% discount.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1311540/

http://store.steampowered.com/app/1013750/

http://store.steampowered.com/app/496890/

http://store.steampowered.com/app/382920/

Best regards,
Somi

notes.title: New game The Wake is coming soon! A SPECIAL OFFER for all other games of Somi!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37698990/c88000e7062b7e1c591bf857068186272a73bf1f.png[/img]


Hi, there. Everyone.

[h2]We are super proud to announce that our new game [b]The Wake[/b] is [b]COMING SOON[/b]![/h2]

The Wake is the last of Somi’s “Guilt Trilogy,” consisting of Replica and Legal Dungeon. The Wake discovers past emotions and wounds through the process of reading and deciphering the journal.


Watch The Wake launch trailer:
[previewyoutube=2Y2PTbchzF0;full][/previewyoutube]


The game developer Somi aspires to deliver his thoughts and stories to people through games. 
Replica describes his guilt regarding to widespread signs of fascism in his country. Legal Dungeon shows his sorrow over the dehumanized legal system which is related to his own job.
And finally in The Wake, Somi focuses on his deeper root of guilt. The game is filled with his own memories and past wounds.

[quote=Somi] I hope the distress of the single person can be a source of comport to someone else. [/quote]


You can WISHLIST the new game here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1311540

notes.title: Cell Phone Horror Mystery: Sara Is Missing
notes.notes: Sara is Missing [official site] has you combing through a cell phone you’ve found in an attempt to locate its missing owner, the titular Sara. If it sounds familiar, that’s because it definitely is. Developers Monsoon Lab say they’re inspired by Replica, where you have to find and highlight pertinent information in order to progress, and I’m reminded of the Mr. Robot companion mobile game too (which was excellent, by the way). However, unlike Replica’s dystopian themes, Sara is Missing is firmly a horror story. It’s out now and not expensive, so have a look. … [visit site to read more]
